name: Rekarina 1.1.0
body:
Rekarina 1.1.0

New
- Saves: the launcher's Saves page brings a save in from another port of the game or from an emulator (Ryujinx and
  its forks, the yuzu family), or from a folder or .zip you pick. The save it replaces is kept and comes back with
  one press.
- Raw mouse camera: the camera turns exactly as far as the mouse moves, with no stick curve or dead zone; swimming
  turns at the same speed. Mouse sensitivity, a separate vertical speed and an invert switch in the menu.
- FSR 1 on the 3D scene (the menu's Upscaler row): a smaller scene scaled up, at the same small cost on any GPU. The
  launcher picks it first on built-in graphics and on 4 GB cards.
- Trees, bushes and grass on GPUs without mesh shaders, and the short grass on AMD's Windows driver.
- HD rumble for the console's own controllers (Pro Controller, Joy-Con).
- Every cutscene can be skipped, the three the console keeps unskippable included.
- Faster dialogue (Game tab, off by default): the text runs on without the pauses between phrases.
- Button prompts follow the device you use, as you switch between them: the text prompts at once, the action hint
  at the bottom of the screen with its next action. The keyboard and mouse set is drawn anew.
- Handheld PCs: a handheld profile (ROG Ally, Legion Go, MSI Claw) and the game's own handheld mode on a Steam Deck.

Fixed
- The whites of the hero's eyes were cyan (a shader translation error; 393 shaders are translated again once).
- Dark frames and objects without sunlight for a moment while the camera turned.
- The mouse camera jerked; under water it changed speed and stuttered.
- A game folder made by the launcher showed the console's button prompts for the keyboard and could not change
  prompt sets while the game ran.
- Where DLSS cannot run, FSR takes its place; a saved GPU that is gone gives the best one instead.
- Keyboard keys showed around a gamepad's buttons in the action hint.
- In the settings menu a gamepad's X and Y switched things on their own, and the game could close after the menu was
  left with Alt+Tab.

Known issues
- AMD GPUs have been run on one integrated Radeon only; Intel GPUs, a Steam Deck and a ROG Ally have not been run.
- There is no Linux release yet.
